svg.aria-label: Volume and section-area errors from nine actual mesh extractions. Both plots use logarithmic axes, with section areas evaluated at z₀=0.5 mm. The table records triangle count, volume, and error for every resolution and threshold. Halving spacing reduces default-threshold volume error by approximately a factor of four.
